design_change.observed_problem: Live Scheduled Task execution showed that self-rearming the currently active one-shot Worker can be overwritten by its own completion, and expired one-shot re-enable may be delivered as catch-up rather than exact future DTSTART.
design_change.remediation: Execution Worker is forbidden to schedule itself. A separate recurring Wake Broker / Hourly Watchdog is the sole role that arms the Worker. Worker continuations persist durable wake, nudge the Broker, then stop.
